events_detected.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis: Active Shipping Disruption + Iran-Oman Transit Deal
events_detected.summary: Iran-US war active since Feb 2026. Strait of Hormuz remains primary flashpoint. Iran seized tankers (latest confirmed seizure Aug 18). Iran-Oman negotiating transit deal. War-risk insurance premiums tripled (0.125% to 0.4%). EIA forecasts oil prices remain elevated until flows normalize. Shipping largely unchanged but Iran retains significant disruption capacity.
events_detected.notes: Ongoing active conflict. Iran parliament advancing Hormuz service fee legislation. Trump says no talks planned. Ceasefire hopes collapsed Aug 18, oil above $90/bbl on some measures.

events_detected.title: Ebola Bundibugyo Epidemic: Fastest-Growing Outbreak on Record — 5,290 Cases, 2,516 Deaths
events_detected.summary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) now deadliest in country's history. 5,290 confirmed cases, 2,516 deaths as of Aug 19. 837 hospitalized. Africa CDC estimates only 30-40% of infections detected — true caseload could be 3x higher. WHO declared PHEIC. Vaccine doses just arriving. Existing treatments certified for Zaire species, not BDBV — complicating response.
events_detected.notes: Cases accelerating. Underreporting factor 2.5-3x. Vaccine mismatch is critical complication.

events_detected.title: US-Japan Yen Intervention Unraveling: Yen Settles Near 159 After Joint Action
events_detected.summary: Historic US-Japan joint yen-buying intervention conducted. Yen initially rebounded but has slid back to ~159 by Aug 23. BOJ held rate at 1.0% (8-1 vote, Takata dissenting for 1.25%). CNBC reports intervention may have given investors better opportunity to rebuild carry trade. Morgan Stanley notes intervention signals willingness to raise rates sooner.
events_detected.notes: Intervention failure risk high. Carry trade rebuilding undermines intervention.

events_detected.title: UK Gilt Crisis Deepening: 10Y Above 5.0%, BOE Selling Into Bond Rout
events_detected.summary: UK 10-year gilt yield broke 5.0% (highest since July 23). 30Y at 5.7%. BOE still selling gilts into a global bond market rout — Telegraph calls it 'costing taxpayer billions.' deVere Group warns gilts are 'weakest link' in global sell-off. Oil above $90 adding inflation risk. BOE says rates must stay higher for longer.
events_detected.notes: BOE quantitative tightening into a sell-off is unprecedented. Fiscal stress building.

events_detected.title: Hedge Fund Treasury Leverage at $2.4T — Basis Trade $830B, Unwind Risk Critical
events_detected.summary: OFR reports hedge fund cash Treasury holdings at $2.4T (up from $600B a decade ago), levered as much as 100:1. Basis trade at $830B (double pre-2020 peak). Adam Tooze warns of unwind risk. Leveraged arbitrage strategies account for nearly half of long positions. Fed reduced enhanced leverage-capital requirements for SIBs effective April 1, 2026.
events_detected.notes: Systemic risk building. Fed loosened capital requirements while leverage hit record levels.

events_detected.title: Russia Slow-Motion Bank Run: €24.4B Withdrawn, Kremlin May Seize Deposits for War
events_detected.summary: Russians withdrew €24.4B from banking system. Fortune reports 'liquidity crunch so severe it's threatening Russia's ability to fund its war.' Kremlin-linked CMASF warns systemic banking crisis by October 2026 if outflows continue. Fear that Kremlin could freeze/nationalize private deposits. 2026 capital outflows could double invasion-phase totals.
events_detected.notes: Active bank run accelerating. War funding pressure creating depositor panic.

events_detected.title: Global Bond Market Sell-Off: Borrowing Costs at Pre-Financial-Crisis Levels
events_detected.summary: Telegraph reports global bond markets 'on fire' as borrowing costs soar to pre-financial-crisis levels. UK 10Y above 5%, 30Y at 5.7%. US Treasurys under pressure from hedge fund leverage unwind risk. Oil price inflation feeding into yields. Middle East ceasefire collapse triggered latest leg of sell-off.
events_detected.notes: Coordinated global sell-off. Central banks all tightening or holding tight.

events_detected.title: Argentina Sovereign Risk Premium Widening — Central Bank Reform Unlocks Reserve Borrowing
events_detected.summary: Argentina's sovereign risk premium widening (Merval -1.89%). BCRA reform bill changes mandate to currency preservation only, bans Treasury financing. DNU 736/2026 opens dollar lending. PxQ consultancy warns reform could unlock borrowing against reserves — increasing sovereign risk. Brazil Selic at 14% after 25bp cut Aug 5.
events_detected.notes: Not yet emergency but trajectory concerning. Reserve-backed borrowing is risk escalation.
